title: Prepare Kairos for its first public release
goal: Produce an evidence-backed open source release plan for this repository.
context: Kairos coordinates work shared by people and agents. This example demonstrates parallel discovery, exclusive Claims, durable results, and a join.
constraints: Inspect the repository only. Do not modify files while completing this demonstration.
acceptance_criteria: The final result identifies release blockers, prioritizes follow-up work, and incorporates both parallel reviews.
